title: ixd wt new reports which open worktrees touch the same files; stack only overlapping tickets, start the rest in parallel off master
description: The repo-plan stack ran one ticket at a time (mean 1.23 ticket agents running against 2.96 on Oct 15) because every ticket was stacked on the previous one with wt new --base. Evidence: ai-workspace reports/tool-review-2026-10-18.md item 1. wt new should take the ticket's related-files (and, for an existing worktree, its diff) and list every open worktree whose diff touches the same files or packages, recommending --base only for those; ixd wt status shows the same overlap. The coordinator then starts non-overlapping tickets in parallel off master.
definition-of-done:
1. ixd wt new <t> prints the open worktrees whose changes overlap the ticket's related files, with the overlapping paths, and suggests --base only when there is overlap.
2. ixd wt status shows the same overlap for an existing worktree.
3. Shown on the current open worktrees.
testing-plan: 1. Run wt new for a ticket overlapping an open worktree and one that does not; paste both outputs.
